notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Spectral Arcanist is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
description:
Activate Spectral Arcanist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Spectral Arcanist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Spectral Arcanist.
Resolve a Spectral Arcanist trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing  you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
